narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Fifteen is less than one hundred twenty five, so the handkerchief easily fits.
<bookmark mark='spill'/>Lay that square on the cloth and it hangs over every edge.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Its area is fifteen times fifteen, two hundred twenty five square centimetres, far more than the cloth has.
